rows.grounds: dative of purpose indicating the desired attainment of prosperity
optative verb prescribing a ritual oblation
agent who performs the prescribed ritual act
first member of a compound expressing the condition to be pacified
dative of purpose completing the compound with the preceding member

items.question: For what purposes should the mantra-practitioner perform a ritual oblation?
premises: A ritual oblation is prescribed as an action to be performed.
The mantra-practitioner is the designated agent of this oblation.
The intended purposes are the attainment of prosperity and the pacification of great poverty.
items.inference: Therefore, the mantra-practitioner should perform the oblation to secure prosperity and to pacify great poverty.
items.plain_english: For prosperity and for the pacification of great poverty, the mantra-practitioner should perform an oblation.
